verdict.rationale: Bento documents a Postman Collection that covers every API endpoint. That is a machine-readable API description that can stand in for a spec, and an API reference browser lists request and response fields. No OpenAPI document is evidenced, and the docs do not say the collection can be downloaded as a spec file. missing for 10: an OpenAPI/Swagger spec file, an explicit downloadable spec URL, schema-level detail confirmed in the machine-readable artifact, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Our [Postman Collection] covers every Bento API endpoint, so you can call the API directly from any language.
This browser gives you one place to scan Bento endpoints, request fields, response fields, and the matching hand-written docs.
